To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a deep neural network can be used to segment cardiac MRI images and extract cardiac function parameters.

we have developed a deep learning approach that allows for fully-automatically segmentation of cardiac MRI data and that the resulting mass and function parameters show a good agreement with the manual segmentation of a cardiologist.
a deep learning approach can be used to reliably determine biventricular function parameters, especially in the right ventricle.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a deep learning approach for fully-automatized segmentation of the right and left ventricle, allowing for the calculation of biventricular function parameters.
the automatic segmentation of the heart from cardiac MRI scans.
the application of deep learning for the extraction of clinically relevant cardiac function parameters.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the presented method allows for fully automated extraction of cardiac function and mass parameters with high reliability.

the proposed deep learning approach is a promising alternative to manual segmentation, and that the proposed adjustment procedure is a viable approach to account for distinct segmentation philosophies.
ν-net is a promising approach for the segmentation of the right and left ventricle in cardiac MRI.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we present a deep learning approach for fully-automatized high quality segmentation of cardiac MRI data, allowing for the extraction of cardiac mass and function parameters.

we introduce ν-net – a deep learning based segmentation approach for the automated determination of cardiac function parameters in high quality, which is robust against distinct segmentation philosophies, allowing for the analysis of novel data sets without the need for retraining.
we developed an algorithm that can segment the heart in a fully automated way and can be used to determine mass and function parameters of the heart.
The main takeaway from our work is that
deep learning is capable of providing reliable results for cardiac function parameters.
deep learning approaches can be successfully applied to the segmentation of the human heart and the extraction of cardiac function and mass parameters.
deep learning can provide reliable results for a large set of clinically relevant parameters, and can therefore be a useful tool for cardiac MRI analysis.
